QuestInfo.name: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 4
QuestInfo.1: Chil Nam was puzzled that his stack didn't seem to decrease, and asked me if I could place another #t4031229# on his brother's stack.
QuestInfo.2: I received a #t4031229# from Chil Nam, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Sung's house.

0.0: Did you make sure my brother did not notice a change in the stack of rice? It's weird, though; my stack of rice hasn't changed one bit. Don't you think so, too? This is why... um... can you go back to my brother's house once more?

yes.0: Please, please make sure my brother does NOT find out about this.

no.0: I'm sorry that I asked you to do the same thing twice.

1.0: I see a stack of rice stacked at the garden of Chil Sung's house. Secretly, I brought out a sack of rice and laid it unnoticeably on top of the stack.

item.0: This is Chil Sung's stack of rice.

lost.0: I think you forgot to take #t4031229#.
